crop_rectangle2 — MV resample op

• Data kinds: image2d → image2d

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.crop_rectangle2(image, row, col, phi, length1, length2) -> 'np.ndarray' (to call the implementation directly, import image_gen; image_gen.crop_rectangle2(image, row, col, phi, length1, length2) -> 'np.ndarray'; from the registry, opsmv.get("crop_rectangle2"))

• HALCON equivalent: crop_rectangle2 (the HALCON reference is a useful guide to its meaning and parameters)

• GPU: none (CPU reference implementation only)

Usage

Read the inside of a rotated rectangle by linear interpolation and cut it out as an axis-aligned image.

> The detailed description below is the original text — the summary and the headings are translated.

矩形は中心 (row, col)、長軸の半分 length1、短軸の半分 length2、向き phi [rad]。向きはこの repo の矩形(gen_rectangle2_contour_xld)と同じで、phi が正だと長軸は右へ進むほど行が増える。出力は (2 length2 + 1, 2 length1 + 1)。空の入力(image が 0 要素)は ValueError。
